description: NDI 音视频网络工具集，包含发现、监看、路由、采集、Webcam Input 与 Bridge
notes: 使用官方 Inno Setup 安装器并指定 Scoop 版本目录；NDI Tools 的 Webcam/HX Driver/Codec 等功能需要系统组件，安装或更新可能需要管理员权限
这是完整安装方案，不是纯便携解包；卸载时会调用官方卸载器以清理驱动和注册项
安装前会检查同一 Inno AppId 的原生/WinGet 注册项；如检测到 Program Files 等外部安装，安装会中止，请先卸载旧版再重试
pre_install: $conflicts = foreach ($uninstallKey in $uninstallKeys) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstallKey) { $entry = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $uninstallKey -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $installLocation = [string]$entry.InstallLocation; $normalizedInstallLocation = if ($installLocation) { [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($installLocation).TrimEnd('\') } else { '' }; $managedByScoop = $normalizedInstallLocation -and $normalizedInstallLocation.StartsWith($appRoot, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -and ($normalizedInstallLocation.Length -eq $appRoot.Length -or $normalizedInstallLocation[$appRoot.Length] -eq '\'); if (-not $managedByScoop) { [PSCustomObject]@{ Key = $uninstallKey; DisplayName = [string]$entry.DisplayName; Version = [string]$entry.DisplayVersion; InstallLocation = $installLocation } } } }

if ($conflicts) { $details = ($conflicts | ForEach-Object { '{0} {1} at {2}' -f $_.DisplayName, $_.Version, $_.InstallLocation }) -join '; '; throw "检测到已存在的原生 NDI Tools 安装 ($appId)：$details。请先卸载该安装，再执行 scoop install ndi-tools" }
